section_summary.extract_value: This section presents between-group differences in BAS-2 scores between men and women across a sample of 1033 university participants. Item-level comparisons revealed that men had significantly higher mean scores on 5 of 10 items, while women had higher scores on one item, with the overall BAS-2 total score being significantly higher in men (t(1031) = 2.37, p = .021), though the effect size was small (d = 0.15). Additionally, no significant differences in body appreciation were found across different universities (F(6, 1025) = 0.69, p = .660).
